game.title: God of War
game.blurb: Norse mythology action-adventure from Santa Monica Studio, released 2018-04-20. RAWG average playtime: 15 hours. Genre: Action. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The journey from the first steps to the end of the main quest. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Muspelheim, Niflheim and the Valkyries
chapters.summary: The trials of Muspelheim, the Niflheim workshop, the realm languages and the nine Valkyries.

chapters.title: Collectibles, Favors and Secrets
chapters.summary: Artifacts, Odin's ravens, treasure maps, Jötnar shrines, wayward spirits, dragons and Brok and Sindri's favors.

chapters.title: Gear, Skills and Combat
chapters.summary: Armour, enchantments, Runic Attacks, the Leviathan Axe, health and rage upgrades, and armour sets.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has the guide under "God of War (2018)" at completion stage 1, but its walkthrough chapter pages (such as "The Marked Trees" and "Path to the Mountain") are linked and not written; only Controls, Gameplay, Resources and a Table of Contents exist, so no structure was taken from it (the generated StrategyWiki reason text says stage 0, which is not exact). godofwar.fandom.com answers the API under "God of War (2018)", with about 266 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. RAWG's first search hit was the 2005 original (slug god-of-war); the detail was replaced with god-of-war-2 (id 58175, "God of War (2018)"). The Steam schema calls the app "Internal 8 PC"; the store list confirms app 1593500. 14 of 37 Steam achievements are hidden and sit in the main story chapter, but "Why Fight It?" (23.2 percent, listed among optional ones), "Beneath the Surface" and "Death Happened Here" may be optional content and need checking.
